description_zh: 查零跑车型与配置，比较年款版本差异，解读公开功能，按预算和补能条件整理选车候选并附来源。覆盖 C10、C11、C16 的 2027 款共 17 个版本。基于公开信息，非官方服务。
description_en: Look up Leapmotor models and trims, compare versions, explain public feature information, and shortlist options by budget and charging needs with cited sources. Covers 17 China-market 2027 trims across C10, C11 and C16. Unofficial public information assistant.
author: EnderZhou
